items.question: Do the researchers discuss limitations, threats to validity, assumptions, or scope boundaries?
items.rationale: The discussion explicitly identifies limitations, assumptions, design decisions, future work, tool-specific constraints, and mission-scope restrictions.
evidence: However, the development of the proposed CubeSat SysML model formalization and its integration with open-source tools for PD involved several limitations and design decisions, and assumptions
One significant limitation encountered, as anticipated, was the modeling-tool-specific nature of the parser.
Another limitation is the focus on low Earth orbit (LEO) missions

items.question: Is the nanosatellite/CubeSat mission context and lifecycle stage described clearly enough to interpret applicability?
items.rationale: The paper is explicitly about CubeSat preliminary design and demonstrates the approach on the academic TWC mission concept, including mission objective and orbit context.
evidence: This paper focuses on formalizing a CubeSat model for use across various stages of the PD phase.
The chosen case study is the "The White Compass (TWC) mission, a theoretical academic concept developed during the "Space Mission and Systems Design" course at Politecnico di Torino.
The TWC mission aims to deliver GNSS services across the Arctic region using a constellation of 12 small satellites in two high elliptical Molniya-like orbits

evidence: The proposed framework possesses the following main three steps:

items.question: Are claimed outcomes explicitly linked to MBSE artifacts, MBSE activities, or model-enabled process changes rather than asserted generically?

quality_checklist.overall_rationale: Strong paper for an open-source CubeSat MBSE preliminary-design workflow with clear artifacts, limitations, and toolchain availability; evidence is mainly a theoretical case-study proof of concept, with limited formal traceability and no physical, operational, or comparative validation.

bibliographic_review_management.status_rationale: Retained as core because the full text directly addresses CubeSat MBSE preliminary design, reusable SysML/UML model formalization, open-source tool integration, and power/EPS-related model-based analyses.
bibliographic_review_management.citation: Luccisano, G.; Salas Cordero, S.; Gateau, T.; Viola, N. Open-Source Data Formalization through Model-Based Systems Engineering for Concurrent Preliminary Design of CubeSats. Aerospace 2024, 11, 702. https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace11090702
bibliographic_review_management.title: Open-Source Data Formalization through Model-Based Systems Engineering for Concurrent Preliminary Design of CubeSats

RQ1.rationale: The article directly formalizes a reusable CubeSat SysML model and abstracts operating modes and subsystem data so preliminary design can proceed with limited detailed behavioral modeling.

RQ2.rationale: It provides explicit reproducibility and integrability claims for open-source SysML-to-simulation workflows and power-budget analyses, but reliability claims are mostly generic and not EPS-specific or empirically validated.

RQ3.rationale: It shows model-derived EPS requirements lists and pre-physical power/data budget simulations, but it does not define or trace formal EPS verification procedures to model artifacts.

bibliographic_review_management.lineage_overlap_notes: The paper positions itself as extending NSS/open-source CubeSat preliminary-design work and MBSE challenge discussions cited in the paper; no other corpus papers or previous extractions were consulted.

study_context_population.mission_platform: Generic CubeSat spacecraft model; use case is the TWC small-satellite constellation concept.
study_context_population.size_form_factor: CubeSat/small satellite; specific U-class form factor not reported for TWC.
study_context_population.mission_name: The White Compass (TWC) theoretical mission concept; also a generic CubeSat formalization.
study_context_population.mission_domain: GNSS services across the Arctic region; generic CubeSat preliminary design and concurrent engineering.
study_context_population.organization_type: Academic/research and open-source context involving Politecnico di Torino and ISAE-SUPAERO/Nanostar ecosystem.
study_context_population.project_maturity: Theoretical academic mission concept and proof-of-concept preliminary validation; no physical development, launch, or operations reported.
study_context_population.lifecycle_stage_addressed: Preliminary design phase, including concurrent design sessions and model-to-analysis iterations.
study_context_population.development_context: Open-source, academic, and budget-constrained CubeSat development using MBSE plus concurrent engineering and NSS analysis tools.
study_context_population.model_maturity: Formalized SysML/UML stereotype profile and Gaphor parser implemented with a TWC proof of concept and public repository; no independent reuse or operational validation reported.

mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Address data fragmentation and poor continuity between CubeSat SysML models and preliminary-design simulations by making a reusable, open-source CubeSat model the central data source for design parameters, operating modes, and budgets.
modeling_scope: CubeSat system architecture and subsystem/component BDDs
UML stereotypes for SystemComp, SystemMain, Battery, SolarArray, Transmitter, Receiver, Orbit, PropagationLosses, GroundStation, and OperatingMode
Requirements list extraction and dependency-graph generation
Parser/database bridge to NSS simulation tools for power and data budgets
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_level_of_abstraction: Spacecraft/system-level preliminary-design model with selected subsystem/component data and mission-environment entities such as orbit and ground station; mostly structural/data abstraction rather than detailed behavioral dynamics.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.minimal_or_excluded_modeling: Excludes detailed treatment of non-nominal/EOP modes such as detumbling, calibration, and safe modes; detailed AOCS/propulsion behavior and formal physical test models are future work; NSS eccentricity limitations are acknowledged.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Users need mission concept, nominal operating-mode activation criteria, and approximate subsystem power/mass/data/orbit/ground-station values; detailed component behavior is not required at early stages.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.handling_limited_behavioral_knowledge: The method abstracts behavior into generalized operating-mode attributes, standby/on/peak consumption states, default/priority rules, and computeMass/computeCons flags that allow system-level values when lower-level components are not yet specified.
model_artifacts_used: NSS-generated power and data budget plots/reports
generality_reuse_mechanism: Reusable stereotype definitions with standardized attributes and units
Generic operating-mode activation and priority schema
Parser reusable for Gaphor models compliant with the proposed stereotypes
Model data can be changed while retaining the same formalization
Tool/language-agnostic concept, though current parser implementation is Gaphor-specific

implementation_steps_or_phases.step: Characterize design data in the CubeSat SysML model
implementation_steps_or_phases.inputs: Design parameters, operating-mode characterization, CubeSat architecture, requirements, modeling tool/methodology.
implementation_steps_or_phases.outputs: Stereotyped SysML model and model file containing architecture, OMs, requirements, and design parameters.
implementation_steps_or_phases.actors_roles: Systems engineer, discipline engineers, students/design team.
implementation_steps_or_phases.prerequisites: Modeling tool capable of SysML/UML diagrams and applying the proposed stereotypes; preliminary mission data available.
implementation_steps_or_phases.completion_criteria: Relevant spacecraft, orbit, ground-station, subsystem, EPS/power, communications, OM, and requirements data are represented with stereotypes.
implementation_steps_or_phases.handoffs: Model file handed to the parser for extraction.

implementation_steps_or_phases.step: Parse the model file and generate exchange artifacts
implementation_steps_or_phases.inputs: Model file, dedicated parser, known stereotype definitions, and model-file structure.
implementation_steps_or_phases.outputs: Software-readable database plus optional requirements list and dependency graph.
implementation_steps_or_phases.actors_roles: Systems/software engineer maintaining the parser and engineering team consuming outputs.
implementation_steps_or_phases.prerequisites: Current implementation assumes Gaphor model files; stereotypes must be applied consistently.
implementation_steps_or_phases.completion_criteria: Required parameters for selected simulations and reports are extracted without manual re-entry.
implementation_steps_or_phases.handoffs: Database handed to NSS or other simulation/analysis tools.

implementation_steps_or_phases.inputs: Database, NSS or other selected tools, analysis configuration, mission/OM data.
implementation_steps_or_phases.outputs: System budgets, reports, power profiles, data budgets, and trade-off inputs.
implementation_steps_or_phases.prerequisites: Simulation tools can consume the generated data structure and the selected budgets are within tool capability.
implementation_steps_or_phases.completion_criteria: Power/data or other required budgets are produced for design review and iteration.
implementation_steps_or_phases.handoffs: Results handed back to the engineering team and, where supported, to model-update scripts.

implementation_steps_or_phases.step: Update and iterate the central model
implementation_steps_or_phases.inputs: Analysis results, optimized parameters, and reverse parsing/update scripts.
implementation_steps_or_phases.outputs: Updated model file/source of truth for the next PD iteration.
implementation_steps_or_phases.prerequisites: Model update logic implemented for affected parameters.
implementation_steps_or_phases.completion_criteria: Design changes are reflected in the model without manual intervention where supported.
implementation_steps_or_phases.handoffs: Updated model returns to CE/PD workflow.

implementation_pathway_tailoring.mapping_to_se_activities_lifecycle_gates: Maps to preliminary design requirements capture, architecture definition, subsystem budgeting, mission analysis, trade-off studies, and CE reports; no explicit PDR/CDR or formal V&V gate process is demonstrated.
implementation_pathway_tailoring.approach_classification_rationale: The approach integrates SysML/UML MBSE artifacts with open-source parsers, databases, simulation tools, budget reports, dependency graphs, and iterative model updates rather than using SysML only as documentation.
tailoring_rationale: CubeSat standardization supports a reusable system model.
Open-source tools fit academic and budget-constrained projects.
Preliminary design requires rapid power, data, mass, link, and volume budget iteration.
Early design often lacks complete subsystem detail, so computeMass/computeCons flags allow coarse-grained modeling.
LEO nominal operating modes were selected as the first generalization scope.

mbse_language_method_tool: Gaphor open-source modeling tool for current parser implementation
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_architecture_data_flow: Design parameters and OM characterization are represented through UML stereotypes in a CubeSat SysML model; the model file is parsed into a software-readable database; NSS or other tools consume the database to generate budgets/reports; selected results can be written back to the model so the model remains the single source of truth.
interoperability_mechanisms: Software-readable database between model and analysis tools
Potential reverse parser for automatic model updates
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.syntax_semantic_continuity_evidence: Semantic continuity is provided by stereotypes that define common parameter names, units, and model roles; syntactic continuity is implemented through Gaphor XML parsing and a database, demonstrated by TWC power/data budget generation. Cross-tool continuity is conceptual because model-file storage differs by tool.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.software_hardware_system_integration_rea: Software-to-software integration from SysML model to NSS analyses is demonstrated; no embedded software, hardware-in-the-loop, EPS hardware, or physical integration/test readiness is reported.
toolchain_limitations: Current parser is tailored to Gaphor model files.
Model files are not fully interoperable across SysML tools by default.
TWC eccentricity was considered null because of limitations within the simulation tools used.
LEO nominal operating modes are the primary generalization scope.
Detailed AOCS/propulsion and non-nominal/EOP modes are future work.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.availability_reproducibility: Open-access article; source code, associated documentation, and original data are reported as openly available in a public GitLab repository under GPLv3.

eps_elements_modeled: EPS systemMain block in the system-level BDD
Solar panels and batteries in EPS requirements
eps_verification_specific.eps_requirements_representation: EPS requirements are represented as SysML requirement elements that the parser can export as a requirements list; the excerpt includes EPS power regulation, voltage, solar-panel generation, battery DoD, capacity, and lifetime requirements.
verification_validation_artifacts: Preliminary proof-of-concept validation through TWC case study
pre_physical_development_verification_me: Model-derived database consumed by NSS to simulate power and data budgets before hardware development
Battery capacity and operating-mode power profiles generated from stereotyped model data
Requirements export enables review of EPS requirements, but not verification closure
Dependency graph supports change-impact analysis before physical integration
eps_verification_specific.evidence_verification_integrated_in_mode: The model contains EPS requirements and power-related parameters, and the TWC case generates power-budget plots from model data; however, verification procedures, pass/fail criteria, verification methods, and requirement-to-verification trace links are not modeled explicitly.
eps_verification_specific.integration_test_readiness: Supports preliminary design budget analysis and requirements/report generation; no EPS integration test procedure, bench test, hardware-in-the-loop, or flight validation is reported.

governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.model_governance_strategy: The SysML model is intended as the central data reference/single source of truth, with standardized stereotypes, parser-mediated database generation, and possible automatic write-back after analyses; formal governance roles or configuration-management rules are not reported.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.traceability_to_deliverables_decisions_r: Deliverables include requirements lists, dependency graphs, budgets, and reports that can inform PD trade-offs; no explicit requirement-to-verification trace matrix, decision log, or formal review-gate evidence is shown.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.evaluation_criteria_model_quality_useful: Usefulness is illustrated by successful TWC power/data budget generation and by qualitative discussion of flexibility, precision, efficiency, and reuse; no model-quality metrics, stakeholder scoring, or independent assessment is reported.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.roi_value_realization_evidence: The article claims open-source and reusable modeling can support quicker, cost-effective, budget-constrained design, but it provides no ROI, cost, schedule, or productivity measurements.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.programmatic_gates_critical_design_event: Preliminary design and concurrent engineering sessions are supported; no PDR, CDR, qualification, acceptance, or flight readiness gate is explicitly linked.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.model_derived_performance_indicators_man: Power consumption profiles, required batteries/solar cells, battery capacity percentage, data flow/TC/TM quantities, visibility time, mass/volume/link/data budgets, and requirements-list counts are available or implied; management metrics are not reported.

practical_implementation_pathway.rationale: The paper gives a three-step formalization, stereotype definitions, parser workflow, and TWC case that generates power/data budgets.

toolchain_fragmentation_interoperability.rationale: Data fragmentation is the central problem; the SysML-stereotype-parser-database-NSS chain is demonstrated, though cross-tool interoperability remains limited by Gaphor-specific parsing.

lightweight_resource_constrained_tailori.rationale: The paper targets open-source, academic, and budget-constrained CubeSat design and early-stage incomplete architectures, but it does not quantify resource burden or compare lightweight alternatives.

governance_project_deliverables_roi_valu.rationale: Budgets, reports, requirements lists, and dependency graphs are deliverables linked to the central model; ROI and formal governance are asserted or implied rather than measured.

newspace_agile_distributed_rapid_iterati.rationale: The article discusses CE, real-time collaboration, future real-time versioning/cloud storage, and dynamic updates, but gives no agile/distributed team implementation evidence.

RQ1: A general CubeSat model is built with SysML BDDs plus UML stereotypes that standardize subsystem, orbit, ground-station, communications, EPS/power, and operating-mode data.
Limited behavioral knowledge is handled by abstracting behavior into operating-mode activation criteria, priority/default flags, and coarse power states rather than detailed dynamic behavior.
SystemMain computeMass/computeCons flags let early-stage models use subsystem-level values when component detail is missing.
RQ2: Reproducibility is supported by open-source tooling and a public GPLv3 repository with code, data, and documentation.
Integrability is supported by a parser/database bridge between SysML model files and NSS analyses, demonstrated through TWC power/data budgets.
Reliability benefits are mostly general MBSE/open-source expectations; no EPS reliability improvement is empirically measured.
RQ3: Pre-physical analysis is integrated by extracting model data into NSS power/data budget simulations, including EPS-related battery and solar-array parameters.
EPS requirements can be exported from the SysML model, but verification methods, pass/fail criteria, and trace links are not modeled explicitly.
The paper supports verification-readiness through budgets and requirement visibility rather than formal EPS verification procedures.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: The parser is modeling-tool-specific and tailored to Gaphor.
Model file formats are not fully interoperable across SysML tools.
Operating-mode generalization focuses on LEO missions and excludes EOP/off-nominal scenarios such as detumbling, calibration, and safe modes.
Generic framework may require customization for specialized missions.
NSS tool approximations are acknowledged, including ECC treated as null in the TWC simulation.

Future work includes broader parser compatibility, non-nominal OMs, more detailed AOCS/propulsion, delta-V/propellant budgets, comprehensive dependency graphs, parser output selection interfaces, and other database formats such as SQL.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: Evidence is limited to one theoretical academic mission case and no physical, operational, or flight validation is provided.
No baseline comparison quantifies time, cost, error, integration, or reliability improvements.
EPS modeling is mainly budget/requirements oriented and does not include detailed EPS behavior, fault modes, verification procedures, or hardware tests.
Requirement export is demonstrated, but requirement-to-design-to-verification traceability is not.
Open-source availability supports reproducibility, but no third-party reproduction or repeated reuse is reported.

extracting all the necessary data for simulation and analysis activities becomes feasible, independently from the variety and number of blocks in the model.

One significant limitation encountered, as anticipated, was the modeling-tool-specific nature of the parser.

Classed as core because the paper directly addresses CubeSat MBSE model formalization and includes EPS/power-budget artifacts, but RQ3 evidence should be synthesized cautiously as verification-readiness rather than formal verification integration.
